usedFor: viaSocket Table holds records, and HubSpot receives them as contacts, deals or companies, starting from “New Row Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Row Created” in viaSocket Table, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new row becomes a HubSpot contact from the properties you provide, and the created record comes back.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so give each row an email before “New Row Created” runs it.
